notices.title: Xbox app players: update to Extra Cover 0.5.2
notices.text: Stadium packs now install on the Xbox app version of Cricket 26. If a stadium pack stopped with "changed in a Cricket 26 update", update Extra Cover and install it again.

notices.title: Cricket 26 updated? Reinstall ExtraCam Pulse first
notices.text: After every game update, disable ExtraCam Pulse and install it again before you launch Cricket 26. Skipping this makes the game crash. Still crashing? We can help on Discord.
